english: We're first, nyo~!
After three furious battles in a row.
Feels like we fought more —\nthat's Gamers' fault.
I wonder if the others are safe?
Oh, that was fast!
Huh? The Hinamizawa team is already here!?
Somehow, when we left Hinamizawa,\nit seemed like no time had passed.
Did time rewind again?
That's not it, you see~.\nThis time, I didn't die even once.
Which means?
We returned to Dokoka Town\nfrom that July we'd never been able to move past.
So it went well?
Yup! Hinamizawa's safe,\nand the enemies are gone!
I see… you worked hard.
Satoko-san did splendidly.
I merely cut open the path.\nThat we could seize victory\nis thanks to Cecilia-san and the others.
I wondered how the final all-out battle would go, but\nI believed we could do it with these comrades.\nIt was very reassuring.
That's awfully humble for you, Houki.
I merely spoke my honest feelings!
What happened on the Gamers side?
Black Dejiko showed up, nyo!\nWell, we won, so all's good, nyo.
You came back early.
Pff!!
Hey, Louise!\nStop laughing remembering things!
Hm? Did I do something?
Nothing! Nothing at all!
Right! We saw nothing and heard nothing!
…If you say so.
Hm, the Black Fund team has come too.
Yahoo!\nI brought back a report of total victory!
We were able to take back the 'Angel's Tear'.
Waa!\nCongratulations, Aoi-chan!
We stopped the 'Gustave Kai' launch too.\nIt went well.
'Gustave Kai'? What's the 'Kai'?
My black self was thinking terrible things.\nA plan was underway to use\nGustave in other worlds too.
Firing an infinitely-firing satellite cannon indiscriminately…\n…but the worlds' interactions\nproduced the technology to do it.
It's dangerous after all…\nworlds intersecting!
Right. I think it's a good opportunity\nto consider what to do going forward.
Before that, shall we\ntake a little rest?
I think that's best.\nEveryone must be tired\nin body and mind.
I agree too!
You rest too, Siesta-san?\nCooking for everyone and doing dishes\nis a lot, right?
But who would cook instead?
How about asking Jumarin-san and Dorothy-san\nat the shop, desu~?
Let's have Jumarin-chan and\nDorothy-chan at the shop make something!\nJust once, come on?
That sounds fun!\nIf it doesn't work out, I'll make ramen!
Ramen!\nUm, I'll help too!\nI love ramen… ehehe~!
Ramen can be made in bulk, good idea!
Yes♪ I'll show you\ntender, juicy chashu~!
Soniko's fired up like never before, nyo!
I'll help too!
Me too~!
Let me help too!\nHow about some tantanmen?
Aoi-oneesama's tantanmen is so spicy,\nI think ordinary people\ncan't eat it…
Good grief, I think we should just\nmake ramen already…
(It's fine.\nIt's easier if everyone can rest)
True enough…
Welcome-yoo!
Um, excuse me,\ncould you… do some cooking for us?
What is 'cooking'-kaa?\nAnything in town is okay to eat-yoo!
No, um… I mean,\nwe'd like you to cook things\nthat can't be eaten as-is so they can be eaten.
Make inedible things edible,\nkaa? All right!\nLet's try-shoo! This way-zoo!
Huh? Me…? Do I do something too?
I'll make the inedible\nedible for you-shoo!
Don't tell me, the inedible thing is… me…!?
Here I go-yoo!!\nBZZZZT BZZZZT BZZZZT!!
Uwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!
All done-nee!
Huh!? I-I'm alive…!\nI thought I'd been cooked…
I properly made the inedible\nedible-yoo!
Huh?
What can't you eat-kaa?
Well… I hate vegetables, so like, carrots.
Here, have some glazed carrots.
Ugh… I can't eat this… *munch munch*.
Huh? I can eat it… I can eat it!?\nWhat happened to my body…?
A new power has awakened.
Really…?
The power to eat carrots-nee!
I-I see… that's it…?
Greed is the enemy.
No no no, that's not it —\nwhat did you just do to me?\nWho even are you!?
U-um?
We're on your side.
On our side?
Dorothy? Is that okay-kaa?
I can't tell you everything yet.\nBut believe this much.
We are your allies.
We ended up cooking for ourselves after all.
Ramen's easy, and\neveryone's having fun making it,\nso isn't it fine?
(I hope I can eat it with a fork…)
That aside, what ARE you!?
Even if you ask me what I am…
A veggie-ish alien from somewhere who turned blonde\n'cause flat-coloring was too much hassle, nyu.
The veggie-ish part might be right… haha.
Won't it go back, desu~?
Can't you go back to normal mode?
Seems I can't on my own…
Okay, everyone, got a moment?\nWhile we wait for the ramen,\nlet's organize the current situation.
So for now, the Dark folks\nare all beaten, right?
What they were\nis still a mystery, though.
Were they really enemies we should have fought… ah, no!\nNo point saying that now.\nSorry.
Mie and Kei are alive and well.\nWhere they are and what they're plotting is unknown.
I thought they'd go for Gustave,\nbut they never showed.
No idea what they're thinking.
No doubt they have thoughts, ideas, and senses\nincompatible with normal humans, though.
Currently, our enemies are Mie and Kei,\nand…
My teacher and\n[NOEL]… desu~.
The teacher and [MERU].\nI know that…!
Haven't seen them in a while, and\nno idea what they're plotting.
Aargh! Seriously!\nAfter all we've done,\nit's still full of mysteries!
Speaking of mysteries, there's\n[CLAUDE]-san's blonde hair too.
Any changes besides the hair?
I can eat carrots now.
How stupid!\nDidn't you really awaken\nto some more dangerous power?
No, doesn't feel like that at all…
Come to think of it, [CLAUDE]-kun's\nmemories haven't returned at all?
No… what even am I?
How should I know!
Right…
All right!\nThe special chashu-men is ready!
A masterpiece!
Ehehe~! Melt-in-your-mouth chashu and\njuicy flame-grilled chashu —\nthe double chashu is the key♪
Wow! That's luxurious!\nYou wouldn't get that even at a shop!
Save the complicated talk for later!
You can't do anything on an empty stomach, as they say.
Hey hey! Welcome!
…It's been a while.
We have no business here.
C'mooon!\nThere's nothing we need to rush on right now!
Besides, we agreed\nwe're not enemies, right?\nBack when we were bullying silly Chris!
You remembered.
So? What'd you come for?
Won't you leave dealing with them to me?
Why~?
A master and disciple must settle things.
Though, as long as I kill [MERU],\nI don't care about the rest,\nbut I may as well finish them all?
Though, as long as I kill [NOEL],\nI don't care about the rest,\nbut I may as well finish them all?
But those kids are my toys!
If they fought you seriously,\nthey wouldn't even be toys, would they?
Well, obviously!
Then let me show you something more interesting.
And if it's boring?
Then do as you like.
Hmm. Fine, go try?
Mie.
It's fine.\nSeems like she'll do something interesting.
I'll aim to impress. I'm off.
Bye-bye!
Mie. You play too much.
It's play, you know? You still don't get it?
I still cannot accurately\nunderstand the meaning of Mie's 'play'.
You're a machine but you're dumb, Kei-chan.\nPlay IS our job! Ours!
Incomprehensible.
Well, whatever.\nThat's why I'm the king~.
No objections.
Well, time to go.
You wait here.\nI'll finish it quickly.
Yes.
Yes.
Hehe, I said I'd show you something interesting,\nbut I may be the one who enjoys it.
Teacher…
Teacher…
Fufufu!
…You're here, desu~? Teacher.
…You're here, right? Teacher.
Hm, you've learned to sense me.
It was like this before too. The wind… stops, desu~.
There was a time like this before, this air.\nA murky-feeling night.
I don't like it. Wind leaves traces, so I stop it.
I want to know what you're thinking, teacher, desu~.\nThat's why I came without waking anyone, desu~.
I thought one-on-one would be better,\nso I came alone.\nYou've got something to say to me, right?
As I already said.\nI will kill you with my own hands… that's all.
Here and now, desu~?
Wasn't it 'a killer doesn't say kill,\nthey kill in silence'?
…Let's have a match. A fair one.
A match?
A match?
But a match with lives at stake.\nThe place and time are already decided.
Like what Remu-san and Doctor Shinigami did, desu~?
You mean a duel?
You may try a surprise attack, but it'll be futile.\nQuietly plan until the day of the match\nand train yourself.
Won't you tell us the reason\nwe must fight, desu~?
Is running away not an option?
Teacher!
Not an option, right.
Why do you do this, desu~?\nWhy won't you fight alongside us, desu~…
I can tell you have some plan.\nBut what do you want me to do…?\nWhat would satisfy you, teacher…?
…I don't know, I don't know, desu~.
I guess we have to do it…
So that's Eve…
Eve appeared!?
Yes.
Why didn't you tell us right away!
I was watching from 800m away,\nbut if I'd moved or made a sound,\nI think I'd have been noticed.
[MERU]-chan,\nwere you going to go alone?
[NOEL]-chan,\nwere you going to go alone?
Yes…
I didn't think Reki-san was watching.
Can you hear a conversation 800m away?
Butei are trained in lip reading.
Reading lips 800m away is harder\nthan an eye exam…
Eyes of a cormorant, eyes of a hawk — Reki's eyes.\nNow, let's move out.
Huh?
Huh.
Look, coming all the way to declare war\nmeans she wants us to join in!
If it were just a duel,\nthere'd be no need to set another date.
I agree.\nWe should assume Eve\nintends all of that.
Not ready yet~?\nI'm already prepared~.
Tesura-san?
Huh, already!?
Heard from Reki…
Dawdle and we'll leave you behind.
You all helped me with the Gustave matter,\nso let me repay you\nfor that~.
…Thanks.
Don't try to fight alone.\n…It doesn't go well.
If Houki-san says that much,\nwe have no choice but to give up.
What do you mean by that!?
You finally understand, Houki-chan!
I didn't say I want to cling!\nStop! Don't come! Don't cling to me—!
This is so us.
Combining wisdom and strength to break through trouble —\nthat's fine, isn't it.
That's right, [MERU]-chan!\nLet's do our best together!
[NOEL]-chan!\nIf we all go,\nour courage is 100 times, you know~!
Uu, thank you everyone—!\nI'll do my very best, desu~!!
Then I'll borrow everyone's strength?\nThat's okay, right!
All right, it's like usual now!\nThen…
Dejiko and her merry friends, sortie, nyo—!!
You ruined it!!
This should be the right time and place, desu~…
Teacher hasn't come yet?
This is…!?
Just magical archaeology.
Teacher!
Teacher!
Shikigami, puppets, alchemy… soulless soldiers.\nIt'll be a somewhat fun party, won't it?
Mere fakes!\nYou think those things will be useful!?
Try playing with them. You won't be bored.
I deliberately dragged you in\nto break you so thoroughly, along with my disciple,\nthat you'll spend a quiet retirement at home — that's what it means.
You're demanding we disband!?
Or die.
You're saying let Mie and Kei rule us!?
Yes.
That's no joke!\nThey tried to use Gustave!\nHow could we accept that!
Eve, I can't believe you'd accept\nMie and Kei's rule.\nIs that your true feeling?
I don't ask for understanding.
I'm telling you to choose:\nobey, or be subdued by force!
Like we'd obey!
Then there's no helping it.
Teacher! Here I come, desu~!!
It reminds me of old times… whether I want it or not.
I've never landed a hit on you, teacher, desu~!\nBut now!!
We'll see?
Teacher, let's go!!
You've learned to say that.\nIt used to be 'please', you know.
The past is the past! Now is now!!
Now, huh…
So this is your present…
I don't\nintend to lose, desu~!\nSo I'll win together with everyone, desu~!!
With everyone, fighting together —\nthat's everything I've got!!
Your true strength is bottomless… but!\nI'll show you who Kazenari Tsubasa is with this sword!
Don't be tense. Tension gets read by the opponent.
A battle of feints\nis not what you seek!
Correct… all I seek is results!
From the first time we met\nI thought you were unfathomable,\nbut I never thought we'd face each other like this.
The Dream Hunter's power interests me.\nShow me.
Huh, surprising.\nI thought you'd quit that research fervor\nto do this kind of fighting!
I'm a researcher, now and always.
This is unexpected…
We beat her…!
More anticlimactic than I imagined…?
Don't let your guard down, desu~!\nTeacher can't be beaten by this much, desu~!
Don't relax yet!\nTeacher can't be beaten this easily!
I thought it'd last a bit longer,\nbut it seems it exceeded my calculations.
Well then. Let's go with about this much next.
Eve!? Was the one we just beat a fake!
Not a fake — it was me you fought.\nYou just couldn't beat me, that's all.
What does that mean?\nIt's like dream power…!
Sorry, but I can't reveal the trick.\nIt's too complex for anyone but me to understand.\nIf I had to say…
Magical archaeology.
What kind of archaeology is that, nyo!?
The poppy name erases the fear.\nYou should be grateful.
So the real you also camouflaged yourself\nwith a carefree attitude?
I'll leave that to your imagination.\nNow, round two.
I expected you'd get this far.\nNow, what to do.
Again!
Holding back, huh?
Which is happier, more interesting —\npressing a button that destroys the world in an instant,\nor humans killing each other with weapons? What do you think?
You're researching even that!?
Archaeology and history are inseparable.
More importantly, round three begins.
What on earth is going on…?
No matter how many times we beat her… we can't beat her, desu~…
Teacher, she's not even taking damage…!?
Hard to explain.\nJust think of it as such a technique.
Are you saying you regenerate infinitely…!
Today was just a greeting, so to speak.\nThis is far enough.
Wasn't this a duel?
Who decided a battle\nmust end in a day?
Teacher said she'd kill me, desu~!
Weren't you going to kill me?
I will. But I decide how I kill.\nYou have no right to choose.
Bravo bravo! That was sooo fun!
Mie!!
Did you enjoy it?
It was great! Going pale with shock,\nhearts starting to break —\nso exciting!
You really get it!
I see. Look forward to the next one too.
Teacher!!
Teacher!!
It's a 'to-be-continued' thing!\nThen let me do a little too!\nMufu♪
First up, Remu-chan and Aria-chan!
I won't let you!
Kyaa!!
Uah!?
How's that?\nFewer and fewer fighters remain!\nIsn't it fuuun?
Tch…!
Especially Re-mu — Re-mu's power\nseems kinda cheat-y.\nAnd Kei-chan's annoying.
I won't lose to this much!
Silence.
Kyaaaaaaaaaaah!!
Remu!
You too!!
Ugh…!
That's a bonus!
Danger!
Everyone, get down!
Take cover behind me!
Me too!
I'll protect you all!
That about does it? 'Wait for the whirlwind next episode!'\nSomething like that? Kyahahaha!!
Heal them quickly! [CLAUDE]-san!
I'll help. Who first?
I'll take Remu-san.\n[CLAUDE]-san, take Aria.
This looks pretty bad…
Don't mind me, heal the others!
You and Remu-san are clearly\nthe most badly hurt…
That's not true! I'm used to it!
I'm used to this much too.
If you two keep being stubborn,\nit'll only delay everyone's treatment!\nSit still!
Fine…
Okay…
Others are badly hurt too.\nThey shielded us during the last attack…
I merely did what was natural.
That's right. I'm sturdy!
Treat them quickly and let's head back to Dokoka Town.\nIf we're attacked again here,\nwe can't protect everyone!
Right. Let's hurry!
